paper.title: LaQX: A JAX Toolkit for Neural Quantum State Simulations of Lattice Quantum Many-Body Models
paper.authors: Yuntian Gu, Chaohui Fan, Ruichen Li, Haoxiang Chen, Weizhong Fu, Yixiao Chen, Dingshun Lv, Weiluo Ren, Tao Xiang, Liwei Wang, Mingpu Qin, Xiang Li

results.system_description: Repulsive Hubbard model on 16x4 square-lattice torus, periodic in both directions; H=-t sum_<ij>,s(cdag_i,s c_j,s+h.c.)+U sum_i n_i,up n_i,down; each nearest-neighbor bond once; t=1, U=8, tprime=0; Nup=Ndown=28, total N=56; 1/8 hole doping. No final pinning field, chemical-potential term or constant shift.
results.source_location: Sec. 4.1, paragraph beginning Evaluation of the final states; Eq. (49); paper-associated Hubbard scripts and main.py
results.eligibility_evidence: Original neural backflow determinant. Sec. 4.1 explicitly gives evaluation energies of final states before their separate use as GFMC guides; only those VMC values are entered.
results.notes: Spin populations verified from paper-associated LaQX main.py and Hubbard example scripts at commit c6a3ee5ed889073fdaa7debd32a001ffd72314de: omitted particles_up defaults to particles//2. Exact file hashes retained in PR. 4096 walkers. Error-bar meaning is not specified for these two energies. GFMC values excluded. Initial direct-embedding determinant is not the recorded neural state.

results.system_description: Spin-1/2 J1-J2 Heisenberg model on 6x6 square lattice, periodic in both directions, total Sz=0; H=J1 sum_<ij> S_i.S_j+J2 sum_<<ij>> S_i.S_j, S=sigma/2, each undirected bond once; J1=1, J2=0.5, no constant shift. D4 symmetry projection.
results.variant: periodic neural backflow MPS, bond dimension D=20; analytic Marshall sign; D4 projection; 15000 MARCH steps
results.source_location: Sec. 4.2, final paragraph and Fig. 3 caption; Eqs. (50), (55)
results.eligibility_evidence: Independent evaluation of the final neural backflow MPS is explicitly distinguished from the trailing 200-step training averages. Analytic Marshall sign and finite D4 symmetry projection qualify under current policy.
results.notes: Energy and variance are per site; Var(E_loc)/36=1.7586e-5 J1^2. Error meaning unspecified. Energy is above the rounded ED reference -0.503810; no below-exact conflict.

issues: Sec. 4.4 NES eigenvalues omitted: paper explicitly lacks covariances needed for eigenvalue error bars. GFMC energies omitted as projection-method estimates. Sec. 4.5 Hofstadter energies held pending confirmation that the reported sector-scan means are from a separate fixed-state evaluation; nominal error bars lack autocorrelation correction.
